age.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments.

sex.evidence: 8-10 weeks old mice of both genders were used for behavioural experiments.

dosing.evidence: 8-week old offspring were intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg) 24 hours prior to behavioural testing.

group_housing.evidence: Offsprings were weaned at P21 and housed in groups of up to five animals per cage after weaning. Mice were group-housed where possible.

assays.assay_description: Custom-built Plexiglass three-chamber box (60 x 40 x 22 cm) divided into three chambers connected by doors. Stranger mouse under one cup, empty cup on opposite side. Sociability index quantified manually from time sniffing/crawling on cups. Tested at 1 day, 1 week, and 2 weeks post-injection. Includes DNMTi (RG108, 10 mg/kg) and 5HT2AR antagonist (MDL100907, 1 mg/kg) pretreatment arms.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected either with saline or psilocybin (1 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Each test mouse was placed into the centre chamber and allowed to freely explore and habituate to the three-chamber setup for 10 minutes over 3 consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: The test mouse was then allowed to freely explore chambers for 10 minutes.

food_restriction.evidence: Standard short test; no food in apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard short test; no water in apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: We assessed the social behaviour of these mice using the three-chamber social behaviour test at 1 day, 1 week, and 2 weeks after the single injection

sample_size.evidence: Sample sizes not explicitly stated in the main text provided.

outcomes.summary: A single dose of psilocybin (1 mg/kg, i.p.) durably restored sociability in Cntnap2 -/- KO mice for at least two weeks, while reducing sociability in wild-type mice at 1 day post-treatment. The rescuing effect in KO mice was blocked by pretreatment with the DNMT inhibitor RG108 or with the 5HT2AR antagonist MDL100907. No sex differences detected.
outcomes.statistics: Cntnap2 -/-Vehicle vs Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle p=0.042; Cntnap2 -/-Psilocybin vs Cntnap2 -/-Vehicle p<0.001; Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle vs Cntnap2 +/+ Psilocybin p=0.001; sex effect p=0.850; DNMTi block p=0.003; 5HT2AR-ant block p=0.001
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin-treated homozygous mutant KO group showed a significant increase in sociability compared to the vehicle-treated Cntnap2 -/-Vehicle KO control group (p < 0.001)... the single administration of psilocybin reduced sociability in Cntnap2 +/+ isogenic wild-type group, at 1 day post-treatment (p = 0.001)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg) significantly increased HTR across all Cntnap2 genotypes to similar levels. HTR was abolished by 5HT2AR antagonist MDL100907 pretreatment but not by DNMTi RG108. No sex effect on HTR.
outcomes.statistics: Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle vs Cntnap2 +/+ Psilocybin p<0.001; Cntnap2 -/-Vehicle vs Cntnap2 -/-Psilocybin p=0.001; Cntnap2 +/-Vehicle vs Cntnap2 +/-Psilocybin p=0.006; sex p=0.452; 5HT2AR antagonist block p<0.001; DNMTi vs Vehicle p>0.999
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin significantly increased HTR in all genotype groups (p < 0.001, Cntnap2 +/+ Vehicle vs Cntnap2 +/+ Psilocybin; p = 0.001, Cntnap2 -/-Vehicle vs Cntnap2 -/-Psilocybin; p = 0.006)

judge_notes: Identified 4 distinct assays: three-chamber sociability, HTR, locomotor activity during three-chamber habituation, and self-grooming. Locomotion and grooming were scored from the same habituation video but measure different behavioural domains, so per rubric they are separate assays (matching glm's split rather than qwen's collapse).
Merged all DNMTi/MDL100907/dose-arm/genotype variants of the three-chamber test into a single assay, per the assay-identity rule.

B7 set to 0 for the locomotion assay: DeepLabCut was used only for position tracking (x,y) to compute distance, not for classifying discrete behavioural states; this falls under the rubric's centroid-tracking carve-out despite being pose-estimation software. Overrode qwen who scored B7=1 for the three-chamber test (manual scoring was used there, not DLC).

D4 baseline scored Yes for grooming (pre-treatment habituation grooming data are reported) and for locomotion (DLC tracking during habituation, including pre-treatment, is reported); No for three-chamber sociability (no pre-drug social preference reported).
Sociability outcome direction set to 'mixed' because psilocybin increased sociability in KO but decreased it in WT — qwen's 'increase' missed the WT effect.
